name: globalcity
description: GlobalCity - a massively multiplayer SimCity-classic style game played on a tile map of the whole Earth. Uses Micropolis (GPLv3) artwork.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w tools
